title: The Little House for a Robot
synopsis: The friends help adult operators establish a small rover science station; a rover pauses before a rock and then takes a clear route.
continuity_state: Before: Scout is already landed and the six have completed one short lunar walk; rover and small instruments still need commissioning. After: Rover, antenna, solar panels, surface marker and temperature/light station work; six travelers have returned to the lander. The station can continue after their departure.
